external_product.name: SSG General Ledger client-server package
external_product.description: SSG’s General Ledger client/server package combines an Artemis PRO/AIONix server with AIONix and CP/M clients. Thin clients submit bounded ledger operations; queries, validation, journal posting and durable transactions execute on the server. Authentication, locking, backup and crash-recovery qualification govern supported configurations. SSG retains application ownership, licences, sales and specialist support. AION’s separately scoped engineering work ends with acceptance, maintainer training and source/build handover. The package supplies the three implementation editions and existing licence/packaging items; no new per-seat licensing policy or additional accounting modules are implied.

external_product.description: DRI-owned CP/M 1.4-derived software with the Aurelia platform extensions, supporting Aurelia and Aurelia+.
